arope_provenance.note: revised AROPE, consistent across the whole 2015-2024 window (27 reporters every year) -- no legacy/revised splice is needed here, unlike the long descriptive series in the appendix

anchored_omitted: anchored poverty is a Greece-only reconstruction (anchor_rates.csv has no geo dimension); it cannot enter a 27-country correlation panel and is omitted rather than approximated
arope_wording: AROPE's relationships to AROP, deprivation and low work intensity are partly DEFINITIONALLY STRUCTURED, not necessarily mechanically deterministic: AROPE is a union, and aggregate data do not reveal the component overlaps that would fix the relationship exactly.
